the national and boolean literal rows that refuse N".." and B".." operands at 85 (operand class, not the transfer)

reader.edition-search: grep of AcceptDisplayEmitter.cs, AcceptDisplayBinder.cs and OperandText.cs for Edition, DialectLevel, DialectBehavior, CobolVersion: the transfer (BoundDisplay to Console.Write or WriteLine of the concatenated device strings) consults no edition; the numeric device form is the --numeric-display option (EditionContext.NumericDisplay, default Decimal), not an edition switch.
